scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @foodfinder/web" "npm run dev --workspace @foodfinder/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @foodfinder/api && npm run build --workspace @foodfinder/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @foodfinder/api && npm run lint --workspace @foodfinder/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @foodfinder/api && npm run test --workspace @foodfinder/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @foodfinder/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @foodfinder/web
